name: Everdisplay Optronics (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 2012 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, Everdisplay Optronics (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the production of semiconductor display panels. The company also offers specialized technical consulting services related to this industry throughout China. Its core product line includes a variety of small and medium-sized active-matrix organic light-emitting diode (AMOLED) displays. These advanced display solutions are widely adopted across diverse applications, such as flexible devices, smartphones, wearable technology, tablets, notebooks, and the automotive sector.
